prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to move, summon, and interact with your new desktop pet in seconds.", "Drag & Drop Pet Action", "Try dragging your pet to the corner of your desktop"]
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Explore companion stories and choose the perfect path for your desktop friend.", "Preview Companion World", "Explore Story Paths"]
2: ["Choose & Name Your Desktop Companion", "Pick your companion species and give them a nickname to proceed."]
3: ["Secure Your Companion & Sync Progress", "Sign in to keep your pet saved safely to your account across all your desktop devices.", "Cloud Account Protection Active", "Continue with Account"]
4: ["Creating Your Custom Companion...", "Estimated completion time: under 2 minutes. Your pet is rendering in the background."]
5: ["For best generation quality: use 1 well-lit, front-facing photo without hats or heavy shadows.", "Clear front angle | Bright lighting | Single face"]
6: ["Play completion chime when pet is ready"]
7: ["Choose Your Starting Companion Path", "Select your initial playstyle. Don't worry—you can unlock and switch paths anytime later!"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready + Starter Collar Unlocked!", "Unlocked: Cozy Starter Ribbon Collar", "Meet Companion on Desktop"]
9: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account email to automatically restore your existing pet."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for a personal photo of the user.
